@nav.chats.description: Main navigation rail, tab with an icon above. Short.

@nav.friends.description: Main navigation rail, tab with an icon above. Short.

@nav.agents.description: Main navigation rail, tab with an icon above. AI agents. Short.

@nav.more.description: Main navigation rail, tab that opens a menu of other screens. Short.

@nav.projects.description: Menu item under More in the main navigation rail. Short.

@nav.workflows.description: Menu item under More in the main navigation rail. Automations. Short.

@nav.label.description: Screen-reader name of the main navigation rail. Short.

@time.today.description: Date label on a chat day divider or an Inbox section. Capitalized label. Short.

@time.yesterday.description: Date label on a chat day divider, Inbox section or list row. Capitalized label. Short.

@time.dayAtTime.description: Message timestamp: a day label (Yesterday, Monday, Sat, Jun 20) then a 24-hour clock time (14:34).

@time.justNow.description: How long ago the last reply in a thread was, after the words 'last reply'. Lowercase. Short.

@time.onDate.description: When the last reply in a thread was, after the words 'last reply'; {date} is a short month and day (May 19). Lowercase. Short.

@common.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog or form without saving.

@common.delete.description: Button or menu item that permanently removes something.

@common.remove.description: Button or menu item that takes something out of a list (not permanent deletion).

@common.close.description: Button or screen-reader label that closes a dialog, panel or popover.

@common.edit.description: Button or menu item that starts editing something.

@common.copy.description: Button or menu item that copies text to the clipboard.

@common.copied.description: Brief confirmation after copying to the clipboard. Short.

@common.retry.description: Button that tries a failed action again.

@common.done.description: Button that finishes a step or closes a finished flow.

@common.back.description: Button that goes to the previous step or screen.

@common.next.description: Button that goes to the next step.

@common.continue.description: Button that moves on in a flow.

@common.confirm.description: Button that confirms an action in a confirmation dialog.

@common.create.description: Button that creates the thing described by the dialog.

@common.add.description: Button that adds the selected or typed item.

@common.send.description: Button that sends a message or invitation.

@common.search.description: Placeholder or label of a search field. Short.

@common.loading.description: Shown while something is loading. Short.

@common.more.description: Screen-reader label or menu button that opens more actions. Short.

@common.settings.description: Button or menu item that opens settings. Short.

@common.somethingWentWrong.description: Generic error title when an action fails for an unknown reason.

@common.tryAgainLater.description: Generic error advice after a failure.

@common.ok.description: Button that acknowledges a message. Short.

@common.you.description: Refers to the current user, e.g. in a member list or as a message author. Short.
